name: Annie Hosfeld Photography
brandNarrative:
When John and I were planning our wedding,
you could say I was more than a tad overwhelmed.
There were sooo many decisions to make.On more than one occasion, we’d look at each other say, should we just run out and get eloped?
But alas, we love our families too darn much
for us to tie the knot without them by our sides.

The truth is, your wedding is about so much more 
than the love you share with one another. 
It’s also very much about the love & history you share
 with your family & friends. 

A celebration of the people 
who have helped to make you who you are today.  

Your wedding is a place where your love story
 and your life story intersect.  

There is sacredness and magic here.
The smiles, the tears, the looks, the laughs, 
the affection, the connection.

so I can deliver on your unique needs,
 preferences and values

and with boundless creativity
(not a pocketful of poses)

between you and your loved ones
(makes for better photos!)

take charge when you need me,
 disappear when you don't

weird obsession: improving indoor air quality

hobbies: sewing, crafting, thrifting, packing picnics

happy place: Lancaster County backroads

addicted to: Burt’s Bees peppermint lip balm

pet peeves: fabric softener, Peloton commercials

greatest achievement: The Great Kitchen Reno of ‘16

stress relief: vodka, vacuuming

can’t live without: south facing windows, after dinner walks

reviews.text:
🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
Annie Was Absolutely Amazing!
Annie Hasfield was the second photographer at our wedding on May 25th, 2025, and she was 100% incredible! From the moment she arrived, Annie brought such a warm and personable energy that made everyone feel completely comfortable in front of the camera. Her ability to connect with people and capture genuine moments was truly special. The shots she took were absolutely stellar — full of emotion, beauty, and creativity. We’re so grateful for her talent and presence on our big day. Highly recommend Annie to anyone looking for a photographer who’s both professional and a joy to work with!
reviews.author: William Hall

reviews.text: A thousand thanks to Annie for an incredible experience from start to finish.  As a guy who has little experience with photo shoots, I wasn't sure how comfortable I would be or what to expect - but Annie made it fun!  The energy from Annie created an environment that allowed us to feel natural in front of the camera (which is easier said than done!).  It was incredible to see the end-result once we received our photos. Annie was able to capture candid moments alongside beautiful nature. I couldn't more highly recommend as we were left with memories that will last a lifetime!
reviews.author: Anthony Hayek

reviews.text:
We had such an amazing experience with Annie
! From the very beginning, she was incredibly organized and thoughtful. She created a detailed schedule for the day, which helped everything flow smoothly—and she stuck to it without making us feel rushed at all. Every little detail was captured beautifully, and her easygoing personality made us feel relaxed and comfortable in front of the camera. Looking back at our photos, we’re so grateful to have every moment so perfectly preserved. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Sara Hopkins

reviews.text: Working with Annie for our wedding was the best! After reviewing Annie’s beautiful photos and talking with her for the first time, we knew that she was the right person to capture the day. We love our wedding photos, which showcase the joy, laughter, and energy of the day exactly in the way we were hoping. Annie really listened when we described what we were going for; she took time to learn about us and our loved ones, and I love that she was able to capture so much! In addition to her beautiful work, Annie is incredibly easy to work with. She is an awesome communicator who is extremely organized, warm, and puts everyone around her at ease. It was important for us to find a photographer that we could trust and that we were happy to have with us on our wedding day, and Annie was exactly that. On our wedding day she calmly took care of any last details, handled any issues, worked out logistics with other vendors, and brought out the best in us at the same time. We also really appreciated Annie’s help in working with us on our timeline and guiding us towards thinking through aspects of our wedding day. She really is an expert who makes this all seem effortless. We also had a great experience working with her partner, Devon, on our wedding day. We highly recommend Annie!
reviews.author: Erica Stockton

reviews.text: Annie is absolutely incredible! My husband and I clicked with Annie at our initial meeting and immediately knew that we wanted to work with her. Annie took our engagement photos and wedding photos - she has a way of making you feel comfortable in front of the camera. Annie created a detailed timeline for our wedding day and coordinated arrival times for the makeup/hair team and floral team so that I didn’t have to worry about anything. She (along with Heather from her team) captured every moment of our wedding day with skill, artistry, and attention to detail. From the stunning portraits to the candid shots, every photo was beautiful. Annie is very organized, communicative, and her friendly, calm demeanor made us, our bridal party, family, and guests feel completely at ease. She also provided sneak peaks within a few days and released the full gallery quickly. We cannot recommend Annie enough and look forward to working with her in the future!
reviews.author: Megan Buell
